name: ANSI/IEEE early-break normally-closed contact symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for early-break normally-closed contact, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The anticipated NC contact form identifies opening earlier in a documented mechanism sequence. That order matters only relative to associated contacts and their common operator, which should remain linked across sheets.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Trace which path is interrupted before the other contacts move.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Early break is an operating sequence, not an overcurrent protection pickup characteristic.
